data.one_liner: A Material Design 3 contract enforcing design tokens via type-safe Dart APIs.
data.what_it_does: Enforces Material Design 3 tokens system-wide by replacing free primitives with type-safe equivalents like M3SpacingValue, M3TypeScale, and M3Shape. It maps spacing, shapes, elevations, colors, and motion directly into type checks so off-scale values cause compile errors.
use_when: You want strict enforcement of Material Design 3 token scales across your entire app.
You want design parameters like spacing, text sizes, and elevations to be caught at compile-time if they violate guidelines.
avoid_when: You are building a custom design system that does not follow Material Design 3.
You prefer using standard Flutter primitives without strict type safety wrappers.
strengths: Catches design non-compliance at compile time instead of via code review.
Zero runtime cost through compile-time extension types.
Comprehensive coverage of M3 specs including spacing, typography, colors, iconography, and motion springs.
weaknesses: Locks your codebase into strict Material Design 3 conventions.
Requires learning a new vocabulary of custom token widgets and types.
data.setup_notes: Requires Flutter >=3.27.0 and Dart >=3.6.0. Simply add the package to dependencies and import it.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard Material components without strict compile-time design contract constraints.
